parameters.query: INSERT INTO autodial_campaigns (campaign_key, spreadsheet_id, sheet_name, sheet_url, status, current_day, daily_success_count, daily_success_limit, max_attempts_per_lead, call_window_start, call_window_end, dial_timeout_minutes, last_run_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'active', $5::date, 0, $6::int, $7::int, $8::time, $9::time, $10::int, NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (campaign_key) DO UPDATE SET spreadsheet_id = EXCLUDED.spreadsheet_id, sheet_name = EXCLUDED.sheet_name, sheet_url = EXCLUDED.sheet_url, current_day = EXCLUDED.current_day, daily_success_limit = EXCLUDED.daily_success_limit, max_attempts_per_lead = EXCLUDED.max_attempts_per_lead, call_window_start = EXCLUDED.call_window_start, call_window_end = EXCLUDED.call_window_end, dial_timeout_minutes = EXCLUDED.dial_timeout_minutes, daily_success_count = CASE WHEN autodial_campaigns.current_day = EXCLUDED.current_day THEN autodial_campaigns.daily_success_count ELSE 0 END, status = CASE WHEN autodial_campaigns.status IN ('paused', 'exhausted') THEN autodial_campaigns.status ELSE 'active' END, last_run_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() RETURNING campaign_key, status, current_day, daily_success_count, daily_success_limit, max_attempts_per_lead, call_window_start, call_window_end, dial_timeout_minutes;

parameters.query: WITH stale AS (SELECT q.id, q.campaign_key, q.lead_key, q.sheet_row_number, q.phone_primary, q.attempt_count_today, q.max_touch_limit, q.attempt_count_total, q.locked_until, c.max_attempts_per_lead, c.dial_timeout_minutes, CASE WHEN q.attempt_count_today >= LEAST(q.max_touch_limit, c.max_attempts_per_lead) THEN (date_trunc('day', timezone('Europe/Moscow', NOW())) + interval '1 day' + interval '10 hours 15 minutes') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow' WHEN q.attempt_count_today = 1 THEN NOW() + interval '30 minutes' WHEN q.attempt_count_today = 2 THEN NOW() + interval '60 minutes' ELSE NOW() + interval '90 minutes' END AS next_retry_at FROM autodial_queue q JOIN autodial_campaigns c ON c.campaign_key = q.campaign_key WHERE q.campaign_key = $1 AND q.dial_status = 'dialing' AND q.locked_until IS NOT NULL AND q.locked_until < NOW()), inserted AS (INSERT INTO autodial_attempts (campaign_key, queue_id, lead_key, event_key, attempt_no, sheet_row_number, request_status, result_status, is_live_connect, request_payload, provider_response, call_log_payload, eleven_conv_id, n8n_execution_id) SELECT s.campaign_key, s.id, s.lead_key, CONCAT('timeout:', s.campaign_key, ':', s.lead_key, ':', s.attempt_count_total, ':', COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.locked_until)::bigint, 0)), s.attempt_count_total, s.sheet_row_number, 'timeout', 'timeout', false, jsonb_build_object('reason', 'stale_dialing', 'locked_until', s.locked_until, 'phone_primary', s.phone_primary, 'attempt_count_today', s.attempt_count_today), '{}'::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb, NULL, NULL FROM stale s ON CONFLICT (event_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING event_key), updated AS (UPDATE autodial_queue q SET dial_status = 'retry_pending', next_call_at = s.next_retry_at, locked_by_job = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_attempt_result = 'timeout', last_updated_by = 'autodial_dispatcher', updated_at = NOW() FROM stale s WHERE q.id = s.id RETURNING q.id) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM inserted), 0) AS timeout_events_logged, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM updated), 0) AS stale_rows_recovered;

WITH counts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE q.dial_status IN ('pending', 'retry_pending', 'dialing') AND q.do_not_call = false) AS remaining_active FROM autodial_queue q WHERE q.campaign_key = $1), updated AS (UPDATE autodial_campaigns c SET status = 'exhausted', exhausted_at = NOW(), exhausted_reason = 'queue_empty', updated_at = NOW() FROM counts WHERE c.campaign_key = $1 AND c.status = 'active' AND counts.remaining_active = 0 RETURNING c.campaign_key) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT remaining_active FROM counts), 0) AS remaining_active, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN true ELSE false END AS is_exhausted;
